title: Medina I-71 Shooting Suspect Caught in North Canton, Two Guns Seized - NewsBreak
text:
By Jocelyn Weaver ,
10 hours ago A road rage shooting on I-71 northbound left one person with minor injuries Tuesday afternoon in Medina County, and by the time investigators finished tracing the suspect's car, the trail had run nearly 40 miles south to North Canton. Twenty-six-year-old Thassanai Suwannasin was taken into custody without incident and charged with felonious assault. Automated license-plate cameras were credited with narrowing down where his vehicle had gone, and two firearms were recovered from the car at the time of his arrest. Read full article
